operating_notes.text: Mwanga Transmission Company Limited incorporated in Kenya on 21 April 2026 with POWERGRID holding 40% and Africa50 holding 60% equity for the Kenya Transmission PPP Project.
Board approved raising funds via Unsecured Rupee Term Loan/ Line of Credit of up to ₹4,000 Cr from State Bank of India.
FY26 capex stood at ₹37,279.1 Cr, up 64.9% YoY.
FY26 capex delivered at ₹39,967 Cr against committed ₹35,000 Cr.
Received fines of ₹5.31 lakh each from BSE and NSE for non-compliance with Regulation 17(1) of SEBI LODR regarding board composition for the quarter ended March 31, 2026.
Acquired Tumkur II RE Transmission Limited for ₹15.46 Cr under the TBCB route for integration of 2.7 GW RE potential.
Commissioned Transmission Network Expansion in Gujarat to increase ATC from ISTS, Part-B effective May 13, 2026.
Works in hand ₹1.75 lakh Cr (TBCB ₹1.46 lakh Cr, RTM ₹25,000 Cr, other ₹4,200 Cr), of which ₹50,000 Cr is CWIP.
Bidding pipeline ₹1.19 lakh Cr (₹73,875 Cr under bidding, ₹45,000 Cr to be floated); 6 of 19 projects bid won till July 2026 with gross annual tariff of ₹2,200 Cr.
System availability 99.8%; transmission network 1,86,000 circuit km, 6,34,516 MVA transformation capacity across 291 substations.
Tenth TBCB win in FY27, the 765kV GIS Pune West project in Maharashtra, at ₹199.55 Cr annual transmission charges; FY27 cumulative annual charges won ₹7,863.63 Cr.
Transmission Scheme for integration of Renewable Energy Zone (Phase-II) in Koppal-II (Phase-A & B) and Gadag-II (Phase-A) in Karnataka completely commissioned.

timeline.summary: Power Grid incorporated Kenyan SPV Mwanga Transmission Company with Africa50 (40:60 equity) for the Kenya Transmission PPP Project.
Power Grid board approved raising up to ₹4,000 Cr via an unsecured term loan/line of credit facility from State Bank of India.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹11,665.61 Cr, net profit ₹4,546.33 Cr (+9.7% YoY).
Power Grid Corporation of India Limited’s Board, led by Satyaprakash Dash, recommended a final dividend of ₹1.25 per share (12.50%) for FY2025-26 on May 15, 2026.
Power Grid's Committee of Directors accorded investment approval for three transmission and communication projects estimated at ₹584.13 crore.
Power Grid released its FY26 investor presentation showcasing record capex delivery of ₹39,967 Cr and ₹1.7 lakh Cr in works in hand.

Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region (M/o DoNER) and Ministry of Power (MoP) declared no encumbrance on Power Grid Corporation of India Limited shares for FY2025-26 on 01.04.2026 and 02.04.2026 respectively.
Power Grid submitted the recording links of the analysts and institutional investors meet held on May 18, 2026.
Power Grid reported FY26 consolidated PAT of ₹15,928 crore on revenue of ₹47,684 crore, backed by capex of ₹39,967 crore.
Power Grid received fines of ₹5.31 lakh each from BSE and NSE for non-compliance with board composition rules for Q4 FY26.
Power Grid acquired Tumkur II RE Transmission Limited for ₹15.46 crore on May 29, 2026, under the TBCB route for integrating 2.7 GW of renewable energy in Karnataka.
On June 3, 2026, Power Grid announced the successful commissioning of the Transmission Network Expansion in Gujarat, Part-B project effective May 13, 2026.
Power Grid's Q1FY27 call (7 Aug 2026) explained a 1% YoY PAT dip to ₹3,598 Cr as ₹560 Cr of regulatory drag offset ₹788 Cr of new-asset transmission charges.
2026-10-16: Power Grid was declared successful bidder for the 765kV GIS Pune West intra-state transmission project at ₹199.55 Cr annual transmission charges, its tenth FY27 TBCB win.
Power Grid completely commissioned the Transmission Scheme for integration of Renewable Energy Zone in Koppal-II and Gadag-II in Karnataka on 23 October 2026.
